notes.title: Mac support added!
notes.content: Super Keepy Ups is finally available natively for Mac OS X devices!

notes.title: Basketball Update
notes.content:
The permanent price reduction is effective immediately so take advantage and get your copy of Super Keepy Ups now, and from 7am GMT, 2nd May 2020 the following updates will automatically be made available to you:

1. A new Basketball game mode featuring:
    - Single player high score
    - local 2 player head to head

2. Audio has been remastered and upgraded to create a more adaptive soundtrack!

3. The Unity launcher has been removed, thrusting you directly into the action!
